proof_groups.proof_strategy: Rewrite all three proof bodies against the current expanded target definitions. For entail_wit_1, unfold xizi_double_link_insert_before_anchor. In the member branch, derive the first occurrence, split at the anchor, and distinguish empty versus snoc predecessor prefix. In the sentinel branch, substitute anchor=head, open xizi_dll, derive ~In head nodes from dllseg, rewrite insert_before_nodes as nodes++[inserted], and distinguish empty versus snoc nodes; instantiate the fourth or third disjunct respectively. For return_wit_1, substitute the empty-case equalities, derive inserted<>head from separated fields, construct the singleton segment, and close xizi_dll. For return_wit_2, rewrite the snoc nodes and append result, derive inserted<>head, join the prefix/old-last/inserted cells into the final segment, and close xizi_dll. Validate the rewritten bodies with group-check; do not direct-reuse the existing shape-obsolete bodies.
